# Girl on a Hike

> Award-winning hiking blog documenting Utah adventures with Alicia and her Golden Labrador Charlie, featuring curated dog-friendly trail guides and outdoor recommendations.

Girl on a Hike is a comprehensive resource for hikers and outdoor enthusiasts exploring Utah's diverse terrain, with a special focus on dog-friendly trails and activities. The site combines personal adventure narratives with practical trail information, reviews, and curated recommendations for the hiking community.

## Key Topics

- Utah hiking
- dog-friendly hikes
- hiking trails
- Salt Lake City
- Big Cottonwood Canyon

- Central Utah

## Core Resources

- [Home - Girl on a Hike](https://girlonahike.com): Award-winning hiking blog following Alicia and Golden Lab Charlie through Utah adventures.
- [Dog Friendly Lists - Girl on a Hike](https://girlonahike.com/dog-friendly-list-grid): Curated dog-friendly hiking trails and outdoor activities across Utah.
- [Hiking Archives - Girl on a Hike](https://girlonahike.com/hiking): Archive of hiking content covering Utah trails, waterfalls, and dog-friendly destinations.

## About & Community

- [About - Girl on a Hike](https://girlonahike.com/about): Personal story of Alicia's hiking background and her bond with Charlie.
- [Testimonials - Girl on a Hike](https://girlonahike.com/elements/testimonials): User testimonials from Utah hikers praising trail guides and dog-friendly resources.

## Optional Resources

- [Discount Codes from My Favorite Outdoor Companies! - Girl on a Hike](https://girlonahike.com/elements/discount-codes): Compiled discount codes for outdoor gear, nutrition, and pet rental companies.
